{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes Boost.Test configuration from cmake/module/AddBoostIfNeeded.cmake, depends/packages/boost.mk, vcpkg.json, and contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes Boost.Test from depends, Guix, and CMake packaging recipes, reducing build and tooling friction. While it simplifies dependency management and improves tooling integration like clang-tidy and IWYU, it is reasonably deferrable maintenance rather than a fix for broken builds or release integrity."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp are mechanical include edits following from the framework replacement",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not an IPC change. The single-line edit in src/ipc/test is purely mechanical to adapt to the new test runner."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp are mechanical edits following from the framework replacement",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a kernel change. The updates to kernel unit test files are mechanical test macro and header updates."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds an in-tree unit test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and updates src/test/main.cpp",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-house assertion framework and test runner, realizing long-standing project goals from RFC #34666 and issue #8670. Reviewers highlight that having an in-house customizable framework removes barriers to writing tests, improves assertion failure output via expression decomposition, and enables future test concurrency."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Guix build script modifications belong to build, not developer or operator tools",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a tools change. The only modified script is Guix packaging glue, which falls under the build category."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/wallet/test/* are mechanical include and test assertion adaptations",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a wallet change. Edits to wallet test files merely follow mechanically from the test framework replacement."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
